description: Golden test vectors for the rater: rate(event, pricebook_revision, tenant) -> charge. The rater is a deterministic pure function (operator-plan principle: replaying identical inputs MUST produce byte-identical charges). These vectors are the seed of that CI property test — extend, never mutate; superseded vectors get a new id. All money values are decimal STRINGS (float money is a review-blocking defect). Rates are per 1,000,000 units unless stated. Rounding: charge components computed at 6 decimal places (NUMERIC(18,6)), half-up, summed after rounding.

llama-3-70b.notes: cached_tokens are billed INSTEAD of prompt_tokens for the cached portion: billable prompt = prompt_tokens - cached_tokens. reasoning_tokens are a detail of completion_tokens and are NOT double-billed here; they are listed to allow a differential rate later (this pricebook rates them identically, so the split is informational).

h200-mig-3g.40gb.notes: per-gpu-second rate = $4.50/hr / 3600. slice_fraction is informational (already reflected in the SKU).

expected_charge.notes: prompt billable = 412-128=284 @ 2.50/M = 0.000710; cached 128 @ 0.625/M = 0.000080; completion 1288 @ 10.00/M = 0.012880 (reasoning included within completion at same rate, differential component zero).
client_disconnect_policy=bill_partial: tokens-at-disconnect are billed (disclosed policy, Q6).
provider_fault_policy=zero_charge (Q15): upstream_error events rate to $0; the event stays in the ledger for reconciliation and dispute traceability.
3600 gpu_seconds @ 0.001250 = 4.500000. Same rater, same ledger, different profile — the ADR-0005 property under test.
